reviews.text: Great store! Bought a lot of gifts for my pets. Found a few things out pets stores don't have in California.

Perfect result! Our timid dog was very well groomed and thank you very much for the gentle touch. Our dog also liked being there, even though new places always make him a little nervous. I definitely recommend it to everyone.

Once again, semi-rude service. The salesperson was "busy" (not with sales-related matters) and had no time to say anything other than "it's not there if it's not on the shelf."
The same store also has service-minded salespeople from time to time.
Good service at Christmas, our dog got treats at the checkout and I think we became a regular customer straight away. Large selection of food, treats, toys and care supplies for animals.
